headline: Chinese Stocks Post Worst Monthly Drop Since 2016 Amid AI Selloff
summary: Chinese equities suffered their steepest monthly decline since 2016, driven by a broad selloff in the artificial intelligence sector.
why: China's equity markets are a key barometer for emerging market risk appetite and technology sector valuations globally.

impacts.name: Shanghai Composite Index
impacts.why: A broad selloff in AI-related stocks pushed the index down.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Widespread selling in technology and AI-related shares drove Chinese markets to their sharpest monthly drop in a decade.
